facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Sorrento, on Piazza Tasso, with views over the Bay of Naples and Mount Vesuvius.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hotel Excelsior Vittoria is in the heart of Sorrento, on Piazza Tasso, with panoramic views over the Bay of Naples and Mount Vesuvius.

facts.text: The hotel sits on a cliff above the Bay of Naples.
facts.excerpt: On a cliff above the Bay of Naples and Mount Vesuvius, Grand Hotel Excelsior Vittoria brings together family heritage

facts.text: The hotel has been family-owned since 1834.
facts.excerpt: Family-owned since 1834, the hotel opens directly onto Piazza Tasso while remaining suspended above the sea.

facts.text: The Fiorentino family has welcomed travellers at the hotel for generations.
facts.excerpt: For generations, the Fiorentino family has welcomed travellers with warmth, discretion and a deep sense of place.

facts.text: Fifth-generation members of the Fiorentino family now run the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Today, fifth-generation Fiorentinos are the custodians

facts.text: The Fiorentino family opened the first of the hotel's three buildings, La Vittoria, in 1834.
facts.excerpt: the Fiorentino family built the first of three buildings to accommodate well-to-do travellers, opening La Vittoria in 1834

facts.text: A second building, La Rivale, followed in 1882, and the third, the Swiss-style La Favorita, was built in the early 20th century.
facts.excerpt: A second building, La Rivale, followed in 1882, and the third—the curiously Swiss-style La Favorita—was built in the early 20th century

facts.text: According to legend, the Roman emperor Augustus once built his villa on the hotel's site.
facts.excerpt: This is the site where, according to legend, Augustus, founder of the Roman Empire, once built his villa

facts.text: Rooms are classic in style, with antique furniture and a Sorrentine palette of blues and whites.
facts.excerpt: Classic, with antique furniture set against a Sorrentine paint palette of blues and whites.

facts.text: Many rooms and suites have views over the Bay of Naples, and some have private terraces or balconies.
facts.excerpt: The hotel offers elegant rooms and suites, many with views over the Bay of Naples, private terraces or balconies, and interiors shaped by classic Italian style.

facts.text: The hotel's suites include the Pavarotti Suite, the Caruso Suite and the Margaret Suite, named for famous guests.
facts.excerpt: read like a roll-call of the hotel’s famous guests (the Pavarotti Suite, the Caruso Suite, the Margaret Suite)

facts.text: Terrazza Bosquet serves refined Mediterranean cuisine with panoramic views over the Bay of Naples.
facts.excerpt: Terrazza Bosquet offers Michelin-starred dining with refined Mediterranean cuisine and panoramic views over the Bay of Naples.

facts.text: Terrazza Bosquet holds a Michelin star.
facts.excerpt: Terrazza Bosquet offers Michelin-starred dining

facts.text: Tasting menus at Terrazza Bosquet might include Sorrento-style gnocchi or risotto with cuttlefish lard.
facts.excerpt: tasting menus might include Sorrento-style gnocchi or risotto with cuttlefish lard

facts.text: Terrazza Vittoria serves Campanian produce at lunch, with simple plates such as spaghetti in San Marzano tomato sauce or lentil soup.
facts.excerpt: Laid-back suppers at Terrazza Vittoria make a song and dance of Campanian produce at lunch, with on-point yet simple plates such as spaghetti in a San Marzano tomato sauce or lentil soup.

facts.text: Breakfast is served under frescoes at Ristorante Vittoria, with homemade cakes and marmalades.
facts.excerpt: breakfast under the frescoes at Ristorante Vittoria is a heady procession of homemade cakes and marmalades

facts.text: Boutique Spa La Serra is set in the private gardens, inside a restored 19th-century greenhouse.
facts.excerpt: A secluded wellness retreat in the private gardens, set within a restored 19th-century greenhouse.

facts.text: The spa has private spa suites with jacuzzi and outdoor areas.
facts.excerpt: Dedicated spaces with jacuzzi and outdoor areas for an intimate, highly private wellness experience.

facts.text: Spa facials and massages use products from the Swiss brand Valmont.
facts.excerpt: Facials and massages use products from Swiss beauty brand Valmont.

facts.text: The hotel has a curvy swimming pool looking toward its classical buildings.
facts.excerpt: From the curvy swimming pool, you can gaze at the classical buildings

facts.text: The hotel's historic park has citrus trees and palms.
facts.excerpt: Among citrus trees, palms and Mediterranean calm, the park carries the quiet memory of Excelsior Vittoria.

facts.text: A private lift gives access toward the port area, convenient for boat days to Capri and along the coast.
facts.excerpt: The hotel offers private lift access toward the port area, making boat days to Capri and coastal itineraries particularly convenient.

facts.text: At the seafront below the lift, guests can charter a boat.
facts.excerpt: down to the seafront, where you can charter a boat

facts.text: The hotel arranges private boat days and bespoke itineraries across Capri, Pompeii, Positano and the Amalfi Coast.
facts.excerpt: Private boat days, romantic moments and bespoke itineraries across Capri, Pompeii, Positano and the Amalfi Coast

facts.text: Rooms are wheelchair accessible, and elevators take guests between floors.
facts.excerpt: Rooms are wheelchair accessible, and there are elevators to take guests between floors.

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler named the hotel to its Gold List 2026.
facts.excerpt: Gold List 2026

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the hotel has one of the best views on the Sorrentine Peninsula.
facts.excerpt: For one of the best views on the Sorrentine Peninsula.
